name: ClothoAQA
intro: ClothoAQA 是基于 1,991 段 Clotho 环境音频构建的音频问答基准，通过两阶段众包获得 35,838 个音频-问题-答案三元组，评估模型联合理解音频与自然语言问题的能力。
build_method: 两阶段Amazon Mechanical Turk众包提问与独立回答，经人工筛查、罕见答案修正和音频无重叠分层划分
metric: Accuracy, Top-1 Accuracy, Top-5 Accuracy, Top-10 Accuracy
eval_feature: 音频问答, 二分类与828类单词分类, 一致票与多数票变体, 音频无重叠划分
scale: 1,991段音频、11,946个问题、35,838个音频问答三元组
build_method_en: Two-stage Amazon Mechanical Turk question and independent answer annotation, followed by manual screening, rare-answer correction, and audio-disjoint stratified splitting
eval_feature_en: Audio QA, binary and 828-class single-word classification, unanimous and majority-vote variants, audio-disjoint splits
intro_en: ClothoAQA is an audio question-answering benchmark built from 1,991 Clotho environmental audio clips. Two-stage crowdsourcing produces 35,838 audio-question-answer triplets for evaluating joint audio and natural-language understanding.
scale_en: 1,991 audio clips, 11,946 questions, and 35,838 audio-QA triplets
metric_en: Accuracy, Top-1 Accuracy, Top-5 Accuracy, Top-10 Accuracy

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2204.09634v2 §§II-A, II-B, and III-A–B plus fixed Zenodo record 6473207 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6473207). Release evidence includes validation MD5 41b8f6d906a57d7a5a4ee02bbcdefcc9, train MD5 508513b91001ab17e641eaaa162ca045, and test MD5 6fd0e75dffba561805fa37c668ce99a4. ClothoAQA randomly selects 1,991 Clotho environmental-audio clips of 15–30 seconds. Qualified AMT workers have at least 3,000 approved tasks, at least 95% approval, and an English-speaking location; question authors additionally pass a custom qualification. They create two distinct three-question sets per clip, each with one yes, one no, and one other single-word-answer question. Manual screening rejects wrong question types, speech-content dependence, answer leakage, and direct address. Separate workers provide three answers and yes/no/maybe confidence per question. In-house post-processing repairs typos or semantically replaces answers appearing in only one audio, reducing 1,889 unique answers to 830. Multi-label splitting searches 2,000 candidate 60/40 partitions, keeps the best 50, then splits the remainder 20/20, yielding 1,174/344/473 audio clips, 11,946 questions, and 35,838 answer rows. The binary task uses 12 yes/no answer rows per audio and alone compares unfiltered, unanimous, and majority-vote labels; the multi-class task uses six rows per audio and 828 other-answer classes. Both use audio-plus-question, question-only, and audio-only variants; metrics are binary Accuracy and multi-class top-1, top-5, and top-10 accuracy.
